## Context selection correction

- Automatic context selection ranks the existing local index before asking JEV about at most 64 file candidates. It no longer classifies the whole permitted repository on each refresh.
- Metadata, passage selection and continuations share a ceiling of eight calls and 128 KiB of request bytes. Smaller project limits still apply; larger historical allowances cannot expand this context ceiling.
- Exact standalone refreshes reuse paid decisions across invocation labels. Changed intent, supplied evidence, model or permissions invalidates incompatible answers.
- Required context and explicit task paths retain priority. The full local inventory remains searchable, and explicit continuation can inspect another bounded window. Receipts distinguish window completion from full coverage.
- Source-sharing permission also gates content-derived path selection. Local descriptor search respects the operation deadline.

The window and allowance are ceilings: large descriptions can exhaust the allowance before all 64 candidates are assessed. The existing family admits at most two continuation steps, shared with task refresh. Exact standalone failed/closed inputs fall back locally with explicit reasons and do not create a fresh retry allowance. A normal new native entry retains its existing fresh family. Exact reuse requires unchanged supplied batches and projection; partial indexing can prevent a match.

## Qualification and adoption

This release follows the normal local 4.x qualification path: focused regressions, affected context integration, clean installed archive proof and independent Opus 5.5 review. Synthetic fixtures establish bounded requests, replay, expansion and fallback behavior; they do not prove ordinary accepted development or net cost savings.

This deliberately changes context-selection policy. Adoption is explicit. Publication does not update existing installations or runtime pins. Provider/model defaults, disclosure permissions and deterministic governance authority retain their existing owners.
